b2-ma.title: Negation: Ma + Verb
b2-ma.explanation: ما (ma) negates a present-tense verb directly, with no extra word needed: ما أروح البيت اليوم (ma aruu7 el-bayt el-yoom, "I'm not going home today"). This is different from مب/مو, which only negate nouns and adjectives (مب زين, "not good") -- verbs always take ما.
b2-ma.fact: Gulf Arabic speakers sometimes drop the subject pronoun entirely and rely on the verb's own prefix to carry the person, so "ما أدري" alone (no أنا) is a completely normal, complete sentence for "I don't know."

dialogue.native: ما أدري وين البيت اليوم، والله
dialogue.en: I don't know where the house is today, honestly

dialogue.native: ما تقدر تدري؟ لازم تسأل صديقك
dialogue.en: You can't find out? You should ask your friend

lessons.title: I Don't Drink, I Don't Go

items.ar: ما أشرب قهوة الليل لأنها تخليني ما أنام
items.en: I don't drink coffee at night because it keeps me from sleeping
items.translit: ma ashrab gahwa el-layl li-annaha tkhalleeni ma anaam

items.ar: ما تروح السوق يوم الجمعة لأن كل المحلات مسكرة
items.en: You don't go to the market on Friday because all the shops are closed

items.ar: ما تشربين شاي بارد، تحبين قهوة حارة بس
items.en: You (f) don't drink cold tea, you only like hot coffee

items.ar: ما يروح المجلس بدون ما يشرب قهوة أول
items.en: He doesn't go to the majlis without drinking coffee first
items.translit: ma yruuH el-majlis bidoon ma yishrab gahwa awwal

items.ar: ما تشرب قهوة بالحليب، تحب القهوة بدون حليب بس
items.en: She doesn't drink coffee with milk, she only likes it plain

items.ar: ما نروح المطعم الجديد لأن الأكل هناك ما يستاهل السعر
items.en: We don't go to the new restaurant because the food there isn't worth the price

items.ar: ما تروحون البنك بعد الظهر لأنه يسكر الساعة وحدة
items.en: You all don't go to the bank after noon because it closes at one o'clock

items.ar: ما يشربون قهوة قبل الفطور، الأكل أول عندهم دايما
items.en: They don't drink coffee before breakfast, food always comes first for them

items.ar: مب هذا البيت اللي أبغاه، أبغى بيت أكبر وأقرب من الشغل
items.en: It's not this house that I want, I want a bigger house closer to work

items.ar: هذا مب سعر عادل، السعر الصح أرخص من كذا بكثير
items.en: This isn't a fair price, the right price is much cheaper than this

items.ar: مب هذاك القميص اللي أبغاه، أبغى الأزرق مب الأحمر
items.en: It's not that shirt I want, I want the blue one not the red one

items.ar: هذي مب الطريقة الصح تسوي فيها القهوة، فيه طريقة أزيان
items.en: This isn't the right way to make coffee, there's a better way
items.translit: haadhi mub eT-Tareega es-saHH tsawwi feeha el-gahwa

items.ar: ما رحت لأني تعبان، رحت لأن جدي طلب مني
items.en: I didn't go because I'm tired, I went because my grandfather asked me to
items.translit: ma riHt li-anni ta3baan, riHt li-ann jiddi Talab minni

items.ar: مب لأنه غالي ما شريته، بس لأنه ما يناسبني
items.en: It's not because it's expensive that I didn't buy it, but because it doesn't suit me
items.translit: mub li-annah ghaali ma sharaytah, bas li-annah ma ynaasibni

items.ar: ما نجحت لأن الامتحان سهل، نجحت لأني درست كثير
items.en: I didn't succeed because the exam was easy, I succeeded because I studied a lot
items.translit: ma najaHt li-ann el-imtiHaan sahil, najaHt li-anni darast katheer

items.ar: مب لأني ما أحبه ما رحت العرس، بس لأن عندي شغل مهم
items.en: It's not because I don't like him that I didn't go to the wedding, but because I had important work
items.translit: mub li-anni ma aHibbah ma riHt el-3urs

items.ar: ما شريت هذا القميص لأنه غالي، بس لأنه مب زين
items.en: I didn't buy this shirt because it's expensive, but because it's not nice
items.translit: ma sharayt haadha el-gamees li-annah ghaali, bas li-annah mub zayn

items.ar: مب هذا البيت اللي أبغاه، وما رحت أشوفه أبدا
items.en: It's not this house I want, and I never went to see it
items.translit: mub haadha el-bayt elli abghaah, wa ma riHt ashoofah abadan

items.ar: ما تشرب قهوة الليل، ومب لأنها مرة، بس عشان تنام زين
items.en: She doesn't drink coffee at night, and not because it's bitter, but so she sleeps well

items.ar: ما نروح المحل الثاني لأنه بعيد، بس لأن هذا أرخص وأزيان
items.en: We don't go to the other shop because it's far, but because this one is cheaper and better
items.translit: ma nruuH el-maHal eth-thaani li-annah ba3eed

items.ar: ما دفعت الحساب كله لأن نص الفلوس كافي الحين
items.en: I didn't pay the whole bill because half the money is enough for now
items.translit: ma dafa3t el-Hisaab killah li-ann nus el-fluus kaafi Haaliyan

items.ar: ما عندي فلوس كافية أشري بيت الحين، بس أوفر كل شهر
items.en: I don't have enough money to buy a house now, but I save every month
items.translit: ma 3indi fluus kaafya ashri bayt el-heen

items.ar: ما نصرف كل الفلوس على أشياء ما نحتاجها
items.en: We don't spend all our money on things we don't need
items.translit: ma nisrif kil el-fluus 3ala ashyaa ma naHtaajha

items.ar: مب لأن الفلوس قليلة ما سافرنا، بس لأن ما عندنا وقت
items.en: It's not because we have little money that we didn't travel, but because we don't have time
items.translit: mub li-ann el-fluus galeela ma saafarna

items.ar: ما زارنا خالي من زمان لأنه مشغول بشغله الجديد
items.en: My maternal uncle hasn't visited us in a long time because he's busy with his new job
items.translit: ma zaarna khaali min zamaan li-annah mashghool bishughlah el-jideed

items.ar: ما تدري جدتي شنو صار بالضبط، بس تحس إن الوضع تحسن
items.en: My grandmother doesn't know exactly what happened, but she feels the situation improved
items.translit: ma tadri jiddati shinu saar biD-Dabt

items.ar: ما قدرو يخلون خالي يروح الطبيب، هو ما يحب المستشفى أبدا
items.en: They couldn't get my maternal uncle to go to the doctor, he never likes the hospital
items.translit: ma gidaraw ykhalloon khaali yruuH eT-Tabeeb

items.ar: مب لأننا ما نحب أهلنا ما نزورهم كثير، بس السفر بعيد ومتعب
items.en: It's not because we don't love our family that we don't visit them often, but the trip is far and tiring
items.translit: mub li-annana ma niHibb ahlana ma nzoorhum katheer

items.ar: ما شريت السيارة الحمراء لأني ما أحب هذا اللون كثير
items.en: I didn't buy the red car because I don't like this color much
items.translit: ma sharayt es-sayyaara el-Hamraa li-anni ma aHibb haadha el-loon katheer

items.ar: العباية مب سوداء ومب زرقاء، هي بين اللونين
items.en: The abaya isn't black and isn't blue, it's between the two colors
items.translit: el-3abaaya mub sawdaa wa mub zarqaa

items.ar: ما تبغى الغترة البيضاء لأنها تصير وسخة بسرعة
items.en: She doesn't want the white headdress because it gets dirty quickly
items.translit: ma tibgha el-ghitra el-baydaa li-annaha twassikh bisur3a

items.ar: مب كل بيت أخضر أزيان من البيت الأصفر، السعر مهم كمان
items.en: Not every green house is better than the yellow house, the price matters too
items.translit: mub kil bayt akhdar azyan minal-bayt el-asfar

items.ar: ما رحنا المستشفى لأن الوضع ما كان صعب، بس رحنا زيارة بس
items.en: We didn't go to the hospital because the situation wasn't difficult, but we went just for a visit
items.translit: ma riHna el-mustashfa li-ann el-wad3 ma kaan sa3ib

items.ar: ما نلقى مطاعم زينة قريبة من هنا، كلها بعيدة شوي
items.en: We can't find good restaurants near here, they're all a bit far
items.translit: ma nilga maTaa3im zeena gareeba min hina

items.ar: مب كل مسجد قريب من بيتنا زين، فنفضل المسجد الكبير
items.en: Not every mosque near our house is good, so we prefer the big mosque
items.translit: mub kil masjid gareeb min baytna zayn

items.ar: ما وصلنا السوق قبل ما يسكرون، فرجعنا البيت بدون شي
items.en: We didn't arrive at the market before it closed, so we returned home without anything
items.translit: ma wisalna es-suug gabl ma yiskiroon

items.ar: ما شريت البيت الأخضر لأنه بعيد، مب لأني ما أحبه
items.en: I didn't buy the green house because it's far, not because I didn't like it
items.translit: ma sharayt el-bayt el-akhdar li-annah ba3eed

items.ar: ما زرنا خالي من زمان لأن السفر متعب، بس بنزوره بكرا
items.en: We haven't visited my maternal uncle in a long time because the trip is tiring, but we'll visit him tomorrow
items.translit: ma zirna khaali min zamaan li-ann es-safar mut3ib

items.ar: مب كل شي غالي زين، وما كل شي رخيص وسخ
items.en: Not everything expensive is good, and not everything cheap is bad

items.ar: ما نصرف على أشياء ما نحتاجها، عشان نوفر للسفر هالصيف
items.en: We don't spend on things we don't need, in order to save for this summer's trip

items.ar: أنا مب مريض، بس تعبان شوي من النوم القليل
items.en: I'm not sick, just a bit tired from lack of sleep
items.translit: ana mub mareed, bas ta3baan shway

items.ar: هي مب متضايقة من الشغل، هي متضايقة من صديقتها
items.en: She's not upset about work, she's upset with her friend

items.ar: احنا مب قلقانين على النتيجة، نفكر إنها بتصير زينة
items.en: We're not worried about the result, we think it'll be good
items.translit: iHna mub galgaaneen 3alan-nateeja, nfakkir innaha baytseer zeena

items.ar: هم مب متأخرين، وصلو قبل خمس دقايق بس ما شفناهم
items.en: They're not late, they arrived five minutes ago but we didn't see them

items.ar: مب تعبان اليوم، بس ما أبغى أروح الشغل اليوم
items.en: I'm not tired today, but I don't feel enthusiasm for work
items.translit: mub ta3baan el-yoom, bas ma aHiss biHamaas lish-shughul

items.ar: مب مبسوطة بنتيجة الامتحان، كانت أصعب من اللي درسته
items.en: She's not happy with the exam result, it was harder than what she studied

items.ar: ما كانو زعلانين من القرار، بس كانو متضايقين شوي
items.en: They weren't upset about the decision, but they were a bit annoyed
items.translit: ma kaanaw za3laaneen minal-qaraar, bas kaanaw mutadaayigeen shway

items.ar: مب فخور بهذا الشغل، أقدر أسويه أزيان من كذا بكثير
items.en: I'm not proud of this work, I can do it much better than this

items.ar: مب واحد بس اللي نجح، أكثر الصف نجح هالمرة
items.en: It's not just one who succeeded, most of the class succeeded this time
items.translit: mub waaHid bas elli najaH, akthar es-saff najaH hal-marra

items.ar: ما عندي عشرة بس، عندي خمسة عشر بالضبط
items.en: I don't have just ten, I have about fifteen

items.ar: مب مية درهم كان السفر، كانت أرخص من كذا بكثير
items.en: The trip wasn't a hundred dirhams, it was much cheaper than that

items.ar: ما دفعنا سبعين على العشاء، دفعنا أقل من خمسين
items.en: We didn't pay seventy for dinner, we paid less than fifty
items.translit: ma dafa3na sab3een 3alal-3ashaa, dafa3na agall min khamseen

items.ar: مب اليوم عندي امتحان، امتحاني يوم الاثنين الجاي
items.en: My exam isn't today, my exam is next Monday
items.translit: mub el-yoom 3indi imtiHaan, imtiHaani yoom el-ithnayn el-jaay

items.ar: ما نسافر يوم الجمعة، نسافر يوم السبت الصبح بدري
items.en: We're not traveling on Friday, we're traveling early Saturday morning

items.ar: مب أمس رحت المستشفى، رحت أول أمس مع خالتي
items.en: It wasn't yesterday I went to the hospital, I went the day before yesterday with my maternal aunt

items.ar: ما بيوصل بكرا، بيوصل بعد يومين لأن سفره طويل
items.en: He won't arrive tomorrow, he'll arrive in two days because his trip is long
items.translit: ma bayoosal bukra, bayoosal ba3d yoomayn

lessons.title: Review: Negation with Health, Numbers, Days

items.ar: مب مريض كثير، بس لازم أرتاح يوم أو يومين بس
items.en: I'm not very sick, but I need to rest just a day or two
items.translit: mub mareed katheer, bas laazim artaaH yoom aw yoomayn bas

items.ar: ما عندي عشرين سنة أشتغل هنا، عندي خمس عشرة بس
items.en: I haven't worked here for twenty years, I've worked here for just fifteen

items.ar: مب يوم الخميس العرس، العرس يوم الجمعة الجاية
items.en: The wedding isn't on Thursday, the wedding is next Friday
items.translit: mub yoom el-khamees el-3urs, el-3urs yoom el-jum3a el-qaadima

items.ar: ما كانت متضايقة من النتيجة، كانت مبسوطة كثير بالعكس
items.en: She wasn't upset about the result, she was surely very happy

items.ar: هذا السعر مب غالي ولا رخيص، هو سعر عادل ومناسب
items.en: This price isn't expensive or cheap, it's a fair and reasonable price
items.translit: haadha es-si3ir mub ghaali wala rakhees

items.ar: الجوتي مب غالي زين، بس مب زين مثل السعر
items.en: The shoes aren't very expensive, but the quality isn't worth the price

items.ar: مب كل شي رخيص وسخ، بعض الأشياء الرخيصة زينة كثير
items.en: Not everything cheap is bad, some cheap things are very good

items.ar: ما دفعنا سعر غالي على البيت، دفعنا سعر يناسب دخلنا
items.en: We didn't pay a high price for the house, we paid a price that suits our income

items.ar: مب أخوي اللي سافر، أختي هي اللي سافرت للكويت
items.en: It wasn't my brother who traveled, it was my sister who traveled to Kuwait
items.translit: mub akhooy elli saafar, ukhti hiya elli saafarat lil-kuwayt

items.ar: مب جدي اللي حكى لي القصة، جدتي هي اللي حكتها
items.en: It wasn't my grandfather who told me the story, my grandmother is the one who told it
items.translit: mub jiddi elli Haka li el-gissa, jiddati hiya elli Hakatha

items.ar: ما خالي اللي زارنا أمس، عمي هو اللي زارنا
items.en: It wasn't my maternal uncle who visited us yesterday, my paternal uncle is the one who visited us
items.translit: ma khaali elli zaarna ams, 3ammi huwa elli zaarna

items.ar: مب ابن عمي اللي نجح في الجامعة، ابن خالي هو اللي نجح
items.en: It wasn't my paternal cousin who succeeded at university, my maternal cousin is the one who succeeded

items.ar: البيت مب قريب من الشغل، فلازم أطلع بدري كل يوم
items.en: The house isn't near work, so I have to leave early every day

items.ar: المستشفى مب بعيد كثير، بيوصلونه في عشر دقايق بالسيارة
items.en: The hospital isn't very far, they'll reach it in ten minutes by car

items.ar: مب قريب المطعم من هنا، لازم نروح بالسيارة مب مشي
items.en: The restaurant isn't near here, we need to go by car not on foot

items.ar: ما البنك بعيد، بس الزحمة تخلي الطريق طويل كثير
items.en: The bank isn't far, but the traffic makes the way take a long time
items.translit: ma el-bank ba3eed, bas ez-za7ma tkhalli eT-Tareeg yTool katheer

items.ar: القميص مب أحمر، هو أصفر غامق يبين أحمر من بعيد
items.en: The shirt isn't red, it's dark yellow that looks red from far away
items.translit: el-gamees mub aHmar, huwa asfar ghaamiq

items.ar: مب أزرق البيت، هو أخضر غامق يبين أزرق بالليل
items.en: The house isn't blue, it's dark green that looks blue at night
items.translit: mub azraq el-bayt, huwa akhdar ghaamiq

items.ar: ما السيارة صفراء، هي بيضاء بس فيها غبار كثير
items.en: The car isn't yellow, it's white but it has a lot of dust on it

items.ar: مب أسود جوتيها، هو بني غامق كثير يبين أسود
items.en: Her shoes aren't black, they're very dark brown that looks black
items.translit: mub aswad jootiiha, huwa bunni ghaamiq

items.ar: مب أخوي اللي شرى البيت الأخضر، أنا اللي شريته
items.en: It wasn't my brother who bought the green house, I'm the one who bought it
items.translit: mub akhooy elli shara el-bayt el-akhdar, ana elli sharaytah

items.ar: البيت مب بعيد ولا قريب، هو بين البنك والمسجد بالضبط
items.en: The house isn't far or near, it's exactly between the bank and the mosque
items.translit: el-bayt mub ba3eed wala gareeb, huwa bayn el-bank wal-masjid biD-Dabt

items.ar: ما دفعنا سعر غالي على السيارة الحمراء، دفعنا سعر عادل
items.en: We didn't pay a high price for the red car, we paid a fair price

items.ar: مب اليوم بيوصلون، بيوصلون بكرا لأن سفرهم تأخر
items.en: They're not arriving today, they'll arrive tomorrow because their trip was delayed

items.ar: ما لازم تروح الشغل بكرا لأنه يوم إجازة رسمية
items.en: You don't have to go to work tomorrow because it's an official holiday
items.translit: ma laazim truuH esh-shaghal bukra li-annah yoom ijaaza rasmiyya

items.ar: ما لازم تدفع الحساب كله الحين، تقدر تدفع نصه بس
items.en: You don't have to pay the whole bill now, you can pay just half of it
items.translit: ma laazim tidfa3 el-Hisaab killah el-heen

items.ar: ما لازم تلبس شي رسمي للمجلس، الملابس العادية زينة
items.en: You don't have to wear anything formal for the majlis, regular clothes are fine
items.translit: ma laazim tilbas shay rasmi lil-majlis

items.ar: ما لازم تدرس كل الكتاب، بس الدروس الأولى للامتحان
items.en: You don't have to study the whole book, just the first chapters for the exam

lessons.title: She Doesn't Have To, You All Don't Have To
lessons.titleNative: ما لازم تروح، ما لازم تروحون

items.ar: ما لازم تروح خالتي معنا، تقدر تجي بعدين لو تبغى
items.en: My maternal aunt doesn't have to go with us, she can come later if she wants

items.ar: ما لازم تروحون المطار كلكم، واحد بس يكفي يستقبله
items.en: You all don't have to go to the airport, just one of you is enough to receive him

items.ar: ما لازم تدفعون كل الفلوس هالشهر، تقدرون تدفعون شوي شوي
items.en: You all don't have to pay all the money this month, you can pay in installments
items.translit: ma laazim tidfa3oon kil el-fluus hash-shahar

items.ar: ما لازم تتصلون كل يوم، تتصلون كل أسبوع بس يكفي
items.en: You all don't have to call every day, calling every week is enough
items.translit: ma laazim tittasiloon kil yoom, tittasiloon kil isboo3 bas yikfi

lessons.title: I Don't Know, You Don't Want

items.ar: ما أدري وين المفتاح، شفت البيت كله وما لقيته
items.en: I don't know where the key is, I looked through the whole house and didn't find it
items.translit: ma adri wein el-miftaaH, shift el-bayt killah wa ma ligeetah

items.ar: ما تبغى تسافر الحين، تبغى تخلص شغلك أول
items.en: You don't want to travel now, you want to finish your work first

items.ar: ما أدري ليش هو زعلان، ما قال لي شي عن السبب
items.en: I don't know why he's upset, he didn't tell me anything about the reason

items.ar: ما تبغى تروح لوحدها، تبغى حد يروح وياها
items.en: She doesn't want to go alone, she wants someone to go with her
items.translit: ma tibgha truuH liwaHdaha, tibgha Had yruuH wiyaaha

lessons.title: They Don't Know, We Don't Want

items.ar: ما يدرون كم الساعة الحين لأن ساعاتهم كلها وقفت
items.en: They don't know what time it is now because all their watches stopped

items.ar: ما لازم نتأخر على العرس، فلازم نطلع من الحين
items.en: We must not be late to the wedding, so we must leave now
items.translit: ma laazim nit'akhkhar 3alal-3urs, fa-laazim nTla3 minal-heen

items.ar: ما يدرون وين يروحون هالصيف، يفكرون بأماكن كثير بس ما قررو
items.en: They don't know where to go this summer, they're thinking of a lot of places but haven't decided

items.ar: ما لازم نصرف كل فلوسنا على السفر، لازم نوفر شي عشان بعدين
items.en: We shouldn't spend all our money on travel, we must save something for the future

lessons.title: Review: Negation with Lazim, Know, Want

items.ar: ما لازم تدري كل شي الحين، بس لازم تدري المهم بس
items.en: You don't have to know all the details now, but you must know the important ones
items.translit: ma laazim tadri kil et-tafaaseel el-heen

items.ar: أبغى كل العائلة تجي معنا، مب أروح لوحدي
items.en: I want the whole family to come with us, not go alone
items.translit: abgha kil el-ahl tiji ma3ana, mub aruuH liwaHdi

items.ar: ما يدرون ليش تأخرنا، ما قدرنا نتصل فيهم بسبب الجوال
items.en: They don't know why we're late, we couldn't call them because of the phone

items.ar: ما لازم تبغى كل شي دفعة وحدة، بعض الأشياء تاخذ وقت
items.en: You don't have to want everything at once, some things take time
items.translit: ma laazim tibgha kil shay daf3a waHda

items.ar: ما صحيت بدري اليوم، ما رحت الشغل، وما درست للامتحان
items.en: I didn't wake up early today, I didn't go to work, and I didn't study for the exam

items.ar: ما طبخنا اليوم لأننا كنا متعبين، طلبنا من المطعم بدل
items.en: We didn't cook today because we were tired, we ordered from the restaurant instead
items.translit: ma Tabakhna el-yoom li-annana kinna mut3ibeen

items.ar: ما اتصلو فينا اليوم، بس ما قلقنا لأنهم مشغولين دايما
items.en: They didn't call us today, but we didn't worry because they're always busy

items.ar: ما نظفت البيت اليوم، بكرا انشاالله عندي وقت أكثر
items.en: I didn't clean the house today, tomorrow God willing I'll have more time
items.translit: ma nadhdhaft el-bayt el-yoom, bukra inshaallah 3indi wagt akthar

items.ar: ما زرنا جدي هالأسبوع لأننا كنا مشغولين، بس بنزوره الجمعة
items.en: We didn't visit my grandfather this week because we were busy, but we'll visit him on Friday

items.ar: ما سافرنا هالصيف لأن الفلوس ما كانت كافية، بس بنسافر الجاي
items.en: We didn't travel this summer because the money wasn't enough, but we'll travel next
items.translit: ma saafarna has-sayf li-ann el-fluus ma kaanat kaafya

items.ar: ما شرينا شي جديد هالشهر، نوفر عشان نشري بيت أكبر
items.en: We didn't buy anything new this month, we're saving to buy a bigger house

items.ar: ما رحنا العرس لأننا كنا في السفر، بس اتصلنا فيهم من هناك
items.en: We didn't go to the wedding because we were traveling, but we sent a gift
items.translit: ma riHna el-3urs li-annana kinna fis-safar

items.ar: مب مبسوط ولا زعلان بالنتيجة، هي عادية مثل ما فكرت
items.en: I'm neither happy nor sad about the result, it's normal like I expected

items.ar: ما كانت مبسوطة بالعرس، بس ما كانت زعلانة كمان، كانت عادية
items.en: She wasn't happy at the wedding, but she wasn't sad either, she was neutral

items.ar: مب زعلانين من القرار، بس مستغربين شوي لأنه كان سريع
items.en: We're not upset about the decision, but we're a bit surprised because it was fast

items.ar: ما هو مبسوط بالشغل الجديد، بس ما هو زعلان، هو مستغرب بس
items.en: He's not happy with the new job, but he's not upset either, he's confused

items.ar: ما كل أصحابي ياو للعرس، بس أهم واحد يا وهذا يكفيني
items.en: Not all my friends came to the wedding, but the most important one came and that's enough for me

items.ar: مب كل أهلي يعرفون بالخبر لسا، بنقول لهم شوي شوي
items.en: Not all my family knows the news yet, we'll tell them little by little
items.translit: mub kil ahli ya3rifoon bil-khabar lissa

items.ar: ما صاحبي اتصل فيني، أنا اللي اتصلت فيه أول
items.en: My friend didn't call me, I'm the one who called him first
items.translit: ma saaHbi ittasal feeni, ana elli ittasalt feeh awwal

items.ar: مب كل قريب زين مثل الأهل الحقيقيين، بس العائلة أهم من كل شي
items.en: Not every relative is as good as the real family, but blood is more precious
items.translit: mub kil qareeb zayn mithil el-ahl el-Hageeqiyeen

items.ar: ما لازم تدري كل شي عن السفر، بس لازم تدري وين ومتى
items.en: You don't have to know everything about the trip, but you must know where and when

items.ar: مب مبسوط ولا زعلان، بس تعبان من كل هالشغل هالأسبوع
items.en: I'm neither happy nor sad, just tired from all this work this week
items.translit: mub mabsoot wala za3laan, bas ta3baan min kil hash-shughul hal-isboo3

items.ar: ما كل أصحابي يدرون بالخبر، بس بيدرون قريب انشاالله
items.en: Not all my friends know the news, but they'll know soon God willing

items.ar: مب أخوي اللي قرر يسافر، أختي هي اللي قررت أول
items.en: It wasn't my brother who decided to travel, my sister is the one who decided first

items.ar: المهندسة ما تشتغل اليوم لأنه يوم إجازة رسمية بالبلد
items.en: The engineer isn't working today because it's an official holiday in the country

items.ar: المترجم ما عنده اجتماعات اليوم، فقرر يرتاح شوي بالبيت
items.en: The translator doesn't have meetings today, so he decided to rest a bit at home

items.ar: التاجر ما فتح محله اليوم لأنه سافر يشري أشياء جديدة للمحل
items.en: The merchant didn't open his shop today because he traveled to buy new things for the shop

items.ar: المدرسة ما درّست اليوم لأن الطلاب عندهم امتحان ثاني اليوم
items.en: The teacher didn't teach today because the students have an exam in another subject

items.ar: ما أبغى أكل الحين، اكلت كثير بالفطور ولسا شبعان
items.en: I don't want to eat now, I ate a lot at breakfast and I'm still full

items.ar: ما تبغى اللحم اليوم، تبغى سلطة وشي خفيف بس
items.en: She doesn't want meat today, she wants salad and something light only

items.ar: أبغى أطلب من المطعم اليوم، مب أطبخ، عشان أرتاح
items.en: I want to order from the restaurant today, not cook, in order to rest
items.translit: abgha aTlub minal-mat3am el-yoom, mub aTbakh, 3ashaan artaaH

items.ar: ما يبغى قهوة ثانية، شرب كثير من الصبح
items.en: He doesn't want another coffee, he drank a lot since morning
items.translit: ma yibgha gahwa thaanya, sharab katheer mines-sub7

items.ar: ما عندي قميص يناسب هالعرس، لازم أروح أشري واحد جديد
items.en: I don't have a shirt that suits this wedding, I need to go buy a new one

items.ar: ما عندها عباية سوداء، عندها بس الأزرق والأخضر
items.en: She doesn't have a black abaya, she only has blue and green

items.ar: ما عندهم جوتي يناسب الشتاء، لازم يشرون قبل ما يصير الجو بارد
items.en: They don't have shoes suitable for winter, they need to buy before the weather gets cold

items.ar: ما عندي غترة نظيفة اليوم، لازم أغسل واحدة بسرعة
items.en: I don't have a clean headdress today, I need to wash one quickly

items.ar: ما عندنا ملابس دافية كافية للأطفال هالشتاء
items.en: We don't have enough warm clothes for the children this winter
items.translit: ma 3indana malaabis daafya kaafya lil-aTfaal hash-shita

items.ar: ما عنده قحفية تناسب الغترة الجديدة، لازم يشري ثانية
items.en: He doesn't have a skull cap that matches the new headdress, he needs to buy another

items.ar: ما عندها دلاغات نظيفة، كلها وسخة من أمس
items.en: She doesn't have clean socks, they're all in the washer since yesterday

items.ar: ما عندنا وقت نشري ملابس جديدة قبل السفر، بنشري هناك
items.en: We don't have time to buy new clothes before the trip, we'll buy there
items.translit: ma 3indana wagt nishri malaabis jideeda gabl es-safar

items.ar: ما آكل لحم كثير، أفضل السمك والسلطة أكثر
items.en: I don't eat a lot of meat, I prefer fish and salad more

items.ar: ما تاكل قبل الرياضة، تحس بتعب لو اكلت
items.en: She doesn't eat before exercise, she feels tired if she eats

items.ar: ما يحبون الأكل بسرعة، يحبون ياخذون وقتهم زين
items.en: They don't like eating quickly, they like taking their time

items.ar: ما أكلنا في المطعم أمس، طبخنا بالبيت لأنه أرخص وألذ
items.en: We didn't eat at the restaurant yesterday, we cooked at home because it's cheaper and tastier

items.ar: ما أشتغل يوم السبت هالأسبوع لأن عندي إجازة
items.en: I'm not working on Saturday this week because I have a vacation

items.ar: ما تشتغل من البيت، تفضل تروح المكتب كل يوم
items.en: She doesn't work from home, she prefers to go to the office every day

items.ar: ما نشتغل سوا بنفس المشروع، كل واحد له مشروعه
items.en: We don't work together on the same project, each one has their own project

items.ar: ما يشتغلون بعد المغرب، الشركة تسكر الساعة خمسة
items.en: They don't work after sunset, the company closes its doors at five o'clock

items.ar: مب هذا اللي طلبته، طلبت قهوة بدون سكر وهذي فيها سكر
items.en: This isn't what I ordered, I ordered coffee without sugar and this has sugar

items.ar: مب هذي الطريق الصح للمطار، الطريق الصح من هناك
items.en: This isn't the right way to the airport, the right way is from there

items.ar: مب هذا السعر الصح، السعر الصح أرخص بعشرين
items.en: This isn't the right price, the right price is cheaper by twenty

items.ar: مب هذي المشكلة الحقيقية، المشكلة الحقيقية إننا ما تكلمنا زين
items.en: This isn't the real problem, the real problem is that we didn't communicate well

items.ar: ما بيجي أخوي للعرس لأنه سافر لبلد ثاني هالأسبوع
items.en: My brother isn't coming to the wedding because he's traveling outside the country this week

items.ar: ما تجي خالتي معنا اليوم، عندها موعد ثاني في نفس الوقت
items.en: My maternal aunt isn't coming with us today, she has another appointment at the same time

items.ar: ما ييت للاجتماع أمس لأني كنت مريض، بس اتصلت فيهم بعدين
items.en: I didn't come to the meeting yesterday because I was sick, but I sent a report
items.translit: ma yeet lil-ijtimaa3 ams li-anni kint mareed

items.ar: ما ياو المدرسة أمس، الجو كان سيء كثير وسكرو المدرسة
items.en: They didn't come to school yesterday, the weather was very bad and they closed the school
